HediffDef.label: life-force starvation
HediffDef.description: Life Force reserves are critically low. Regeneration is suppressed and the Wraith becomes slow, weak and difficult to keep conscious until it feeds.

HediffDef.label: life-force torpor
HediffDef.description: With no usable Life Force remaining, the Wraith has entered a dormant survival state. Torpor is not directly fatal, but leaves the body almost helpless until some Life Force is restored.

HediffDef.label: wraith hibernation
HediffDef.description: The Wraith has deliberately collapsed its metabolism into a deep survival state. Life Force consumption is reduced to two percent of normal and regeneration nearly stops until the three-day hibernation cycle ends.

HediffDef.label: life drained
HediffDef.description: This pawn has had a large part of its vitality stripped away by Wraith feeding. The visible condition fades as the immediate shock passes, but the biological aging caused by the feeding is permanent.

HediffDef.label: fed recently
HediffDef.description: This Wraith has fed recently. Its regenerative tissues are saturated with stolen vitality and repair injuries much more rapidly for roughly one RimWorld day.
